dimensions.label: Impact and blast radius

matched_incidents.title: Orders ingestion skipped late-arriving records
matched_incidents.root_cause: The incremental watermark advanced before late-arriving source records were committed, while the MERGE key did not enforce source uniqueness.
matched_incidents.impact: Orders were missing from downstream reporting and a subset of records was duplicated.
prevention: Test late-arriving records at watermark boundaries

matched_incidents.title: Duplicate order rows after merge-key update
matched_incidents.root_cause: A nullable business key caused multiple source rows to match the same target record during an incremental MERGE.
matched_incidents.impact: Order counts were overstated in the analytics layer for two reporting cycles.
prevention: Reject or quarantine null merge keys
Check source uniqueness at the target grain

matched_incidents.title: Warehouse merge caused lock contention
matched_incidents.root_cause: A broader MERGE predicate scanned and locked a much larger target range than expected.
matched_incidents.impact: Several downstream finance jobs missed their processing window.
prevention: Review query plans for MERGE changes
Monitor lock waits and job duration

recommendations: Test watermark boundaries, late-arriving records, replay behaviour and backfill safety.
Validate MERGE keys, source uniqueness, idempotency and duplicate/missing-row scenarios.
Run backward-compatibility checks against downstream consumers before deployment.
Test and document the rollback procedure before approving the release.
Use a canary or staged rollout and define an explicit observation window.
Complete the relevant automated regression and data-quality tests before deployment.
Review INC-1042 (Orders ingestion skipped late-arriving records) and verify its documented prevention steps.
caveats: Risk index is a prioritization score, not a probability that an incident will occur.
Weights and thresholds are illustrative and must be calibrated against real release outcomes.
Historical-risk heuristic uses retrieved incidents only: 60% Chroma semantic relevance, 40% structured field overlap, adjusted by historical incident severity. These weights are illustrative.
